theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_scsp_tf_profile_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e x : Euclid P) (φ lam : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ContDiff ℝ 1 lam → 0 < inner ℝ x u → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y : Euclid P => φ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y u)) * lam ‖y‖) x ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P, inner ℝ x h = 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => φ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y u)) * lam ‖y‖) x h = deriv φ (Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x u)) * lam ‖x‖ * ((inner ℝ x u * inner ℝ h e - inner ℝ x e * inner ℝ h u) / (inner ℝ x u ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2))
